purpose: Add a verifier-owned source-work diagnostic for forced trajectories without converting it into an invalid total-energy balance gate.

definitions.kinetic_energy: E(u) = 0.5 * mean(sum_i u_i^2) on the host real-velocity field
definitions.transversality: For every positive-control RK stage, max|K dot Source_hat| must satisfy the declared numerical tolerance.

zero_source: Retain the existing physical-space energy series and any separately justified nonincrease gate.
W_F must be zero up to the declared diagnostic tolerance.
constant_source_source_only_synthetic: Classical RK4 weighted source work equals the exact quadratic energy increment up to roundoff; this is a checker self-test, not a Navier-Stokes acceptance condition.
dynamic_transverse_source: Record P_F at all four RK stages and W_F per completed step.
Record per-stage max|K dot Source_hat| and reject the case as an incompressible positive control if transversality fails.
For a smooth source-only synthetic witness, require the energy-work defect to decrease under timestep halving; do not infer or advertise a formal order from this finite test.
full_forced_navier_stokes: Record E, stage source powers, W_F, divergence, Hermitian residual, fallback state, and dense-vs-hybrid trajectory differences.

Do not require delta E == W_F: convection/discretization, viscosity and any other RHS terms also contribute to the total energy change unless their work terms are separately instrumented and justified.
negative_control: Use a deliberately longitudinal Source to show that a source-work-consistent trajectory can still violate incompressibility; energy-work and divergence checks are orthogonal.

positive_controls: transverse dynamic Source, preferably a time-dependent scalar amplitude times a fixed divergence-free spatial mode
trajectory_level: same-final-time dt=0.002 versus dt=0.001 endpoint comparison

scope_limits: No native spectralDNS/shenfun/FFTW rerun is claimed by this contract.
Source-work alone is not a full Navier-Stokes energy budget.
Energy-work consistency does not certify incompressibility, Hermitian symmetry, dense-vs-hybrid equivalence, PDE convergence or physical correctness.
No formal convergence order is claimed from the synthetic timestep-halving witness.
